limits: This slice verifies recipient-specific queries, receipt, knowledge and reply recovery, not per-unit move/hold/recall commands.

Only these29 GPU processes were rerun: selected left/right/lost-wing reply, known-target movement, save failure, renewal with old mail, sender evidence, held papers, group/historical entry, legacy military/combat, ground material and three smokes. Other prior scenarios including repeated exercise were not rerun in this slice.
Existing ReturnHeldReportHome remains explicitly main-post-only; a held wing failure report is not silently sent to the main post. Manual retargeting of that wing report remains future work.
80m perception and120m local military exercise coefficients are not final terrain visibility or nationwide performance acceptance.
18second fixed60fps recording contains actual personal movement and chronological saved-state cuts; it is not a realtime performance benchmark.

visual_review.method: Actual current-run stills and decoded video frames inspected with view_image. Left/right query updates only corresponding wing after physical receipt; lost reply remains unknown until actual recovery; direct observation replaces past report on return. Terrain nonblank, controls fit. Dense camp labels remain prototype quality, not final label acceptance.
